<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="catalog_script_client"><catalog_script_client action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><applies_catalog>true</applies_catalog><applies_extended>false</applies_extended><applies_req_item>false</applies_req_item><applies_sc_task>false</applies_sc_task><applies_target_record>false</applies_target_record><applies_to>item</applies_to><cat_item display_value="Food Delivery System">88860ed183ae2a10410a73d6feaad397</cat_item><cat_variable>IO:a87e2e5a8326ae10410a73d6feaad3d0</cat_variable><condition/><description/><field/><global>true</global><isolate_script>true</isolate_script><messages/><name>Total Price Calculation</name><order/><published_ref/><script><![CDATA[function onChange(control, oldValue, newValue, isLoading) {
   if (isLoading || newValue == '') {
      return;
   }
   function calculateTotalPrice() {
  var total = 0;

  // Replace 'food_items' with the name of your MRVS
  var mrvs = g_form.getValue('menu_items');

  if (mrvs) {
    var rows = JSON.parse(mrvs);

    for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
      var price = rows[i].food_price;  // Replace 'price' with your field inside MRVS

      // Remove currency symbols and commas
      price = parseFloat((food_price + '').replace(/[^\d.]/g, ''));

      if (!isNaN(food_price)) {
        total += price;
      }
    }
  }

  // Replace 'total_price' with the name of your normal variable
  g_form.setValue('total_price', total.toFixed(2));
}

// Run when the price field changes
calculateTotalPrice();
   //Type appropriate comment here, and begin script below
   
}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-07-10 12:10:51</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>4d44d15783a2e250410a73d6feaad380</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Total Price Calculation</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Food Delivery System" source="x_946454_food_de_0">d660a9d183ea2a10410a73d6feaad3a7</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Food Delivery System">d660a9d183ea2a10410a73d6feaad3a7</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_4d44d15783a2e250410a73d6feaad380</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-07-10 12:10:51</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onChange</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>true</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>
